annotation.title_clean: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy of the Czech Republic
annotation.title_en: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy of the Czech Republic
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Industry and Trade of the Czech Republic (Government of the Czech Republic)
annotation.venue: CEDEFOP Timeline of VET policies in Europe
annotation.summary_en: Czech national AI strategy led by the Ministry of Industry and Trade, framing the country as the "country of robots". It sets objectives and tools across seven chapters to promote AI research, industry automation, SMEs, education and retraining, data and public administration, with commitments to safe, responsible AI including driverless cars, robots and autonomous weapons.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates an AI Committee under the Committee for Digital Economy and Society Strategy to coordinate implementation
Aims to make the Czech Republic a model country for automation and AI research centres of European importance
Commits to ensuring safety where people meet intelligent machines such as driverless cars, robots and autonomous weapons
Supports retraining of workers and SME digital transformation, open data and digital innovation hubs
Aligns with EU strategies and the 2018 Declaration of Cooperation on AI
